query_groups.name: lamet_core
query_groups.query: (cat:hep-lat OR cat:hep-ph OR cat:nucl-th) AND (all:LaMET OR all:"large momentum effective theory")

query_groups.name: quasi_pdf
query_groups.query: (cat:hep-lat OR cat:hep-ph OR cat:nucl-th) AND (all:"quasi-PDF" OR all:"quasi PDF" OR all:"quasi parton distribution" OR (all:quasi AND all:PDF))

query_groups.name: pseudo_pdf
query_groups.query: (cat:hep-lat OR cat:hep-ph OR cat:nucl-th) AND (all:"pseudo-PDF" OR all:"pseudo PDF" OR all:"pseudo parton distribution" OR all:"pseudo-distribution")

query_groups.name: ioffe_time
query_groups.query: (cat:hep-lat OR cat:hep-ph OR cat:nucl-th) AND (all:"Ioffe-time distribution" OR all:"Ioffe time distribution" OR (all:Ioffe AND all:lattice AND all:distribution))

query_groups.name: lattice_cross_section
query_groups.query: (cat:hep-lat OR cat:hep-ph OR cat:nucl-th) AND (all:"lattice cross section" OR all:"good lattice cross section" OR (all:lattice AND all:hadronic AND all:tensor))

query_groups.name: lattice_parton_structure
query_groups.query: (cat:hep-lat OR cat:hep-ph OR cat:nucl-th) AND ((all:lattice AND all:parton AND all:distribution) OR (all:lattice AND all:hadron AND all:structure AND all:x-dependent))

query_groups.name: lamet_gpd_tmd_da
query_groups.query: (cat:hep-lat OR cat:hep-ph OR cat:nucl-th) AND ((all:GPD OR all:TMD OR all:"distribution amplitude") AND (all:quasi OR all:pseudo OR all:LaMET))

query_groups.name: lamet_perturbative
query_groups.query: (cat:hep-ph OR cat:hep-th OR cat:nucl-th) AND ((all:LaMET OR all:"large momentum effective theory" OR all:"quasi-PDF" OR all:"quasi PDF" OR all:"pseudo-PDF" OR all:"pseudo PDF" OR all:"Ioffe-time" OR all:"Ioffe time") AND (all:matching OR all:factorization OR all:kernel OR all:renormalization OR all:"one-loop" OR all:"two-loop" OR all:NLO OR all:NNLO OR all:evolution OR all:"anomalous dimension"))
